{
  "ruff.description": "A Visual Studio Code extension with support for the Ruff linter and formatter for Python.",
  "ruff.capabilities.virtualWorkspaces.description": "Virtual Workspaces are not supported by the Ruff extension.",
  "ruff.contributes.configuration.properties.ruff.nativeServer.markdownDescription": "Whether to use the native language server, [`ruff-lsp`](https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff-lsp) or automatically decide between the two based on the Ruff version and extension settings.",
  "ruff.contributes.configuration.properties.ruff.nativeServer.markdownDeprecationMessage": "**Deprecated**: Please remove this setting. The extension now always uses the native language server. Refer to the [migration guide](https://docs.astral.sh/ruff/editors/migration) for more information.",
  "ruff.contributes.configuration.properties.ruff.nativeServer.deprecationMessage": "Deprecated: Please remove this setting. The extension now always uses the native language server.",
  "ruff.contributes.configuration.properties.ruff.nativeServer.markdownEnumDescriptions.0": "Use the native language server. A warning will be displayed if deprecated settings are detected.",
  "ruff.contributes.configuration.properties.ruff.nativeServer.markdownEnumDescriptions.1": "Use [`ruff-lsp`](https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff-lsp). A warning will be displayed if settings specific to the native server are detected.",
  "ruff.contributes.configuration.properties.ruff.nativeServer.markdownEnumDescriptions.2": "Automatically select between the native language server and [`ruff-lsp`](https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff-lsp) based on the following conditions:\n1. If the Ruff version is >= `0.5.3`, use the native language server unless any deprecated settings are detected. In that case, show a warning and use [`ruff-lsp`](https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff-lsp) instead.\n2. If the Ruff version is < `0.5.3`, use [`ruff-lsp`](https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff-lsp). A warning will be displayed if settings specific to the native server are detected.",
  "ruff.contributes.configuration.properties.ruff.nativeServer.markdownEnumDescriptions.3": "Same as `on`.",
  "ruff.contributes.configuration.properties.ruff.nativeServer.markdownEnumDescriptions.4": "Same as `off`.",
  "ruff.contributes.configuration.properties.ruff.configuration.markdownDescription": "Configuration overrides for Ruff. See [the documentation](https://docs.astral.sh/ruff/editors/settings/#configuration) for more details.",
  "ruff.contributes.configuration.properties.ruff.configuration.oneOf.0.markdownDescription": "Path to a `ruff.toml` or `pyproject.toml` file to use for configuration.",
  "ruff.contributes.configuration.properties.ruff.configuration.oneOf.1.markdownDescription": "Inline JSON configuration for Ruff settings (e.g., `{ \"line-length\": 100 }`). *Added in Ruff 0.9.8.*",
  "ruff.contributes.configuration.properties.ruff.lint.preview.markdownDescription": "Enable [preview mode](https://docs.astral.sh/ruff/settings/#lint_preview) for the linter; enables unstable rules and fixes.",
  "ruff.contributes.configuration.properties.ruff.lint.select.markdownDescription": "Set rule codes to enable. Use `ALL` to enable all rules. See [the documentation](https://docs.astral.sh/ruff/settings/#lint_select) for more details.",
  "ruff.contributes.configuration.properties.ruff.lint.extendSelect.markdownDescription": "Enable additional rule codes on top of existing configuration, instead of overriding it. Use `ALL` to enable all rules.",
  "ruff.contributes.configuration.properties.ruff.lint.ignore.markdownDescription": "Set rule codes to disable. See [the documentation](https://docs.astral.sh/ruff/settings/#lint_ignore) for more details.",
  "ruff.contributes.configuration.properties.ruff.lint.enable.markdownDescription": "Whether to enable linting. Set to `false` to use Ruff exclusively as a formatter.",
  "ruff.contributes.configuration.properties.ruff.format.backend.markdownDescription": "The backend to use for formatting.",
  "ruff.contributes.configuration.properties.ruff.format.backend.enumDescriptions.0": "Use Ruff's built-in formatter.",
  "ruff.contributes.configuration.properties.ruff.format.backend.enumDescriptions.1": "Use uv for formatting (requires uv >= 0.8.13)",
  "ruff.contributes.configuration.properties.ruff.format.preview.markdownDescription": "Enable [preview mode](https://docs.astral.sh/ruff/settings/#format_preview) for the formatter; enables unstable formatting.",
  "ruff.contributes.configuration.properties.ruff.path.markdownDescription": "Path to a custom `ruff` executable, e.g., `[\"/path/to/ruff\"]`.",
  "ruff.contributes.configuration.properties.ruff.importStrategy.markdownDescription": "Strategy for loading the `ruff` executable. `fromEnvironment` picks up Ruff from the environment, falling back to the bundled version if needed. `useBundled` uses the version bundled with the extension.",
  "ruff.contributes.configuration.properties.ruff.importStrategy.enumDescriptions.0": "Use `ruff` from environment, falling back to the bundled version if `ruff` is not found.",
  "ruff.contributes.configuration.properties.ruff.importStrategy.enumDescriptions.1": "Always use the bundled version of `ruff`.",
  "ruff.contributes.configuration.properties.ruff.interpreter.markdownDescription": "Path to a Python interpreter to use to find the `ruff` executable. Requires either the Python Environments or Python extension to be installed.",
  "ruff.contributes.configuration.properties.ruff.enable.markdownDescription": "Whether to enable the Ruff extension.",
  "ruff.contributes.configuration.properties.ruff.organizeImports.markdownDescription": "Whether to register Ruff as capable of handling `source.organizeImports` actions.",
  "ruff.contributes.configuration.properties.ruff.fixAll.markdownDescription": "Whether to register Ruff as capable of handling `source.fixAll` actions.",
  "ruff.contributes.configuration.properties.ruff.codeAction.fixViolation.properties.enable.markdownDescription": "Enable the Quick Fix.",
  "ruff.contributes.configuration.properties.ruff.codeAction.fixViolation.markdownDescription": "Whether to display Quick Fix actions to autofix violations.",
  "ruff.contributes.configuration.properties.ruff.codeAction.disableRuleComment.properties.enable.markdownDescription": "Enable the Quick Fix.",
  "ruff.contributes.configuration.properties.ruff.codeAction.disableRuleComment.markdownDescription": "Whether to display Quick Fix actions to disable rules via `noqa` suppression comments.",
  "ruff.contributes.configuration.properties.ruff.showSyntaxErrors.markdownDescription": "Whether to show syntax error diagnostics.",
  "ruff.contributes.configuration.properties.ruff.logLevel.markdownDescription": "Controls the log level of the language server.",
  "ruff.contributes.configuration.properties.ruff.logFile.markdownDescription": "Path to the log file for the language server.",
  "ruff.contributes.configuration.properties.ruff.trace.server.markdownDescription": "Traces the communication between VS Code and the Ruff language server.",
  "ruff.contributes.configuration.properties.ruff.exclude.markdownDescription": "Set paths for the linter and formatter to ignore. See [the documentation](https://docs.astral.sh/ruff/settings/#lint_exclude) for more details.",
  "ruff.contributes.configuration.properties.ruff.lineLength.markdownDescription": "Set the [line length](https://docs.astral.sh/ruff/settings/#line-length) used by the formatter and linter. Must be greater than 0. Ruff 0.15.12 or older uses a maximum of 320.",
  "ruff.contributes.configuration.properties.ruff.configurationPreference.enumDescriptions.0": "The default strategy - configuration set in the editor takes priority over configuration set in `.toml` files.",
  "ruff.contributes.configuration.properties.ruff.configurationPreference.enumDescriptions.1": "An alternative strategy - configuration set in `.toml` files takes priority over configuration set in the editor.",
  "ruff.contributes.configuration.properties.ruff.configurationPreference.enumDescriptions.2": "An alternative strategy - configuration set in `.toml` files is ignored entirely.",
  "ruff.contributes.configuration.properties.ruff.configurationPreference.markdownDescription": "The preferred method of resolving configuration in the editor with local configuration from `.toml` files.",
  "ruff.contributes.commands.0.title": "Fix all auto-fixable problems",
  "ruff.contributes.commands.1.title": "Format document",
  "ruff.contributes.commands.2.title": "Format imports",
  "ruff.contributes.commands.3.title": "Print debug information",
  "ruff.contributes.commands.4.title": "Restart Server",
  "ruff.contributes.commands.5.title": "Show client logs",
  "ruff.contributes.commands.6.title": "Show server logs",
  "ruff.enumLabels.ruff.nativeServer.0": "On",
  "ruff.enumLabels.ruff.nativeServer.1": "Off",
  "ruff.enumLabels.ruff.nativeServer.2": "Automatic",
  "ruff.enumLabels.ruff.nativeServer.3": "True (legacy boolean)",
  "ruff.enumLabels.ruff.nativeServer.4": "False (legacy boolean)",
  "ruff.enumLabels.ruff.format.backend.0": "Built-in Ruff formatter",
  "ruff.enumLabels.ruff.format.backend.1": "uv",
  "ruff.enumLabels.ruff.importStrategy.0": "From environment",
  "ruff.enumLabels.ruff.importStrategy.1": "Bundled version",
  "ruff.enumLabels.ruff.logLevel.0": "Error",
  "ruff.enumLabels.ruff.logLevel.1": "Warning",
  "ruff.enumLabels.ruff.logLevel.2": "Information",
  "ruff.enumLabels.ruff.logLevel.3": "Debug",
  "ruff.enumLabels.ruff.logLevel.4": "Trace",
  "ruff.enumLabels.ruff.trace.server.0": "Off",
  "ruff.enumLabels.ruff.trace.server.1": "Messages",
  "ruff.enumLabels.ruff.trace.server.2": "Verbose",
  "ruff.enumLabels.ruff.configurationPreference.0": "Editor first",
  "ruff.enumLabels.ruff.configurationPreference.1": "Filesystem first",
  "ruff.enumLabels.ruff.configurationPreference.2": "Editor only"
}
